'''Vandelhelm''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Vandelhelm system/Legends|Vandelhelm system]], inside of the [[Vandelhelm Cloud]] within the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]. It was known for its [[starshipwright]]s, and manufacturing capabilities.

==History==
Prior to its official discovery a underworld criminal faction was named the [[Vandelhelm Combine]] who took part in the [[Syndicate Wars]] in [[3667 BBY]]

[[File:Vandelhelm.jpg|left|thumb|240px|Vandelhelm]]
Even though it was located along the [[Rimma Trade Route/Legends|Rimma Trade Route]], it was not discovered by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] until [[3053 BBY]] due to the planet being obscured from sensors by the [[Vandelhelm Cloud]]. Eventually two independent [[Prospector/Legends|prospectors]] [[Vandel]] and [[Helm]] braved the cloud looking for rich [[Mineral/Legends|minerals]] and metals. Having found the planet to be rich in [[Ore/Legends|ores]], Vandel and Helm settled the planet with their families, now named "Vandelhelm", and after making finds on its surface, they used the profits to form the first [[Metalsmiths Guild]].

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] the planet lay within [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] space.<ref name="TEA" />
